input.title: New protected cycle lane on Karl-Heine-Strasse
input.content:
Since 19 October 2026 a protected cycle lane of 1.2 kilometres runs along Karl-Heine-Strasse, in both directions between the Felsenkeller and the Plagwitz station.

Kerbs separate the lane from car traffic. The city expects more people to ride to work: "More people will ride to work when they feel safe," said the head of the mobility office.

Sources

  • City opens a new cycle lane on Karl-Heine-Strasse, press office of the city of Leipzig, 19 October 2026
